Source sheet on warm neutral background:
1 folded/inactive,
2 activation,
3 active idle,
4 bubble-piercing pulse,
5 empowered pearl glow,
6 upgrade variant.
Same top-down/3-4 game camera, consistent proportions, chunky premium casual-game cartoon, clean outlines, soft cel shading, no text, no UI, original IP.
